test_title: PYST 51: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A class of 42 students took a Physics test. 18 students had an average score of 95. The other students had an average score of 73. What is the average score (rounded off to one decimal place) of the whole class?
solution:
**Given:**

Total number of students = 42

Number of students with an average score of 95 = 18

Average score of the remaining students = 73

**Formula used:**

Class average = dfrac{{Total score of all students}}{{Total number of students}}

**Calculation:**

Total score of 18 students = 18 x 95

⇒ Total score of 18 students = 1710

Total number of remaining students = 42 - 18

⇒ Total number of remaining students = 24

Total score of 24 students = 24 x 73

⇒ Total score of 24 students = 1752

Total score of the whole class = 1710 + 1752

⇒ Total score of the whole class = 3462

Class average = dfrac{3462}{42}

⇒ Class average = 82.4

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
